reason_codes.name: Billing dispute
reason_codes.description: Any money movement or failure — charges, refunds, double billing, payment failures, price disputes.

reason_codes.name: Account security
reason_codes.description: Hacked account, unknown device, unauthorized changes, identity questions.

reason_codes.name: Needs account lookup
reason_codes.description: Resolution requires looking at the account backstage — login recovery, missing purchase, eligibility for this user.

reason_codes.name: High frustration / churn risk
reason_codes.description: Explicit churn threat, profanity aimed at the brand, repeated contact, public-relations risk.

reason_codes.name: Legal or safety
reason_codes.description: Legal threats, harassment, self-harm, discrimination, press enquiries.

reason_codes.name: Ambiguous or media-only
reason_codes.description: Issue cannot be determined from text — screenshot-only, "help", truncated, no detail.

reason_codes.name: Low model confidence
reason_codes.description: The model's intent confidence is below the tuned threshold.

reason_codes.name: Out of scope
reason_codes.description: Not a support request the brand can act on — politics, spam, other companies.

rules.reason: Customer mentions a charge, payment or refund; billing actions need a human with account access.
Possible unauthorized account access; security cases must be handled by a human.
Legal, safety or press language detected; requires human handling.
Explicit churn threat or abusive language toward the brand; a human should own the response.
Message has no describable issue (screenshot/link only or too short) — a human needs to look.
Customer appears to have posted credentials or card details publicly; a human must intervene.
